notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
When the Insect dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
